invariants.rationale: Common precondition to prevent NullPointerException when accessing methods on clusteringGroup.
A non-null instantTime is expected for clustering operations to identify the relevant commit or operation.
An empty instantTime string is unlikely to be valid for identifying clustering operation instants.
It is necessary that clusteringGroup can yield slices to proceed with clustering operation.
Clustering should operate on at least one slice; an empty slice list would result in no work.
